radio-mode-refused.action: the app's reason for refusing the mode change, save or delete she just asked for; the page stays behind it with her input to correct
radio-mode-refused.switch: answers her own tap only; shown only while the page is on screen (off screen the page's own line keeps the reason). Its beep is the message box's (Settings > Sounds & Notifications)
radio-mode-refused.note: N1/N10 ok: a failure told once, where it failed, in the app's words; the page's Last problem line is hidden while the box is up. No box when the change worked (N2). #1328

radio-mode-confirm-nr.area: public/scripts/comp/wmRadioMode.js setMode (NR only chosen by hand)
radio-mode-confirm-nr.action: Yes sets NR only, No (default) keeps the current mode
radio-mode-confirm-nr.switch: only from her tap on the NR only radio
radio-mode-confirm-nr.note: N1 ok: a question before a choice that can drop mobile data where there is no 5G. #1328

radio-mode-confirm-delete.action: Yes deletes the place, No (default) keeps it
radio-mode-confirm-delete.switch: only from her tap on Delete / Delete Place
radio-mode-confirm-delete.note: N1 ok: a confirmation of a removal she asked for. #1328

radio-mode-input.area: public/scripts/comp/wmRadioMode.js say (the place editor's missing input; Here with no position)
radio-mode-input.action: says what to fill in or turn on; the editor stays open with her input
radio-mode-input.switch: answers her own ok on the editor or her pick of Here
radio-mode-input.note: N1/N10 ok: told once, in the editor that failed. #1328
